say:1:1231174001:1.text: Our praying is through, we should head home.
say:1:1231174001:1.source_cn: 祈祷结束，我们该回家了。

say:2:1231174002:1.text: When we get home, we'll mend our nets and fishing gear and wait for the gods to reveal themselves and lift the fog.
say:2:1231174002:1.source_cn: 回家之后，我们会把渔网和渔具都修补好，等待神明显灵、大...

say:3:1231174003:1.text: The gods have their own domains to oversee, and we too must see to our duties and do everything we're supposed to.
say:3:1231174003:1.source_cn: 神明有她掌管的领域，我们也要将自己该做的一切做好。
